description:
Full pre-payment dossier for one agent: ERC-8004 identity, sybil forensics,
    feedback-velocity class (organic/burst/farm) and 30d liveness compliance,
    with an ok / caution / avoid verdict.

    Use before integrating an agent or spending on it repeatedly — it bundles the
    trust-gate, forensics and SLA answers in one call. REST:
    GET /api/v1/agent/{agent_id}/trust-passport ($0.01).
name: get_agent_trust_passport
